rationale: The only code delta is at completion: the fixed implementation copies cb->module and cb->skb into local variables before releasing cb_mutex, then releases/consumes those local references. The Logic section does not specify whether cleanup resources are accessed before or after unlocking, nor does it describe this lifetime/synchronization detail. Its statements about locking, dumping, filtering, sending/freeing, completion, unlocking, and cleanup are either true of both versions or sufficiently abstract to be silent on the delta.
